chapter.heading: Plea for Relief from Bitter FoesA Song of Ascents.
chapter.v:
In my
distress I cried to the Lord,And He heard me.

Deliver my
soul, O Lord, from lying lipsAnd from a deceitful tongue.

What shall
be given to you,Or what shall be done to you,You false tongue?

Sharp arrows
of the warrior,With coals of the broom tree!

Woe is
me, that I dwell in Meshech,That I dwell among the tents of Kedar!

My soul
has dwelt too longWith one who hates peace.

I am
for peace;But when I speak, they are for war.
